name: Wellnhoferia
sum: Late Jurassic avialan from Germany close to Archaeopteryx, with a shorter tail and shorter fourth toe.
holotype: The Solnhofen Specimen (BSP 1999), found near Eichstätt in the 1960s and first described in 1988 as Archaeopteryx; now in the Bürgermeister-Müller-Museum, Solnhofen.
material: Known only from the holotype skeleton.
biology: Differed from Archaeopteryx chiefly in its shorter tail and fourth toe; Mayr and colleagues (2007) and others regard it as a specimen of Archaeopteryx lithographica, while Senter and Robins (2003) supported a separate genus.
author: Elzanowski 2001
